classification.difficultyReason: Identify and count parallel or perpendicular segments in a contextual swing-set drawing.

content.prompt: Consider the diagram of a swing set shown.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2, below stem and left of parts
spec.description: Swing-set framework with top A-B-C-D, ground E-F-G, vertical AE, BH, CI and DF, swing seat HI and diagonal DG. Ground extends beyond E and G. Nine filled junction dots. Single upward parallel chevrons on four verticals, double rightward chevrons on BC and EF. Squares at E, F and H.
spec.mathematics: AE parallel BH parallel CI parallel DF; BC parallel EF; AE perpendicular EG; DF perpendicular EG; BH perpendicular HI.
spec.answerVisibility: Question geometry only; no completed response.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How many line segments are parallel to $AE$?

answer.worked: $BH$, $CI$ and $DF$ have the same single parallel marker as $AE$, so there are 3 other parallel segments.
$AE\perp EG$ and $DF\perp EG$: the squares at $E$ and $F$ mark right angles with the ground line.
